title: FloodGuard Private Flood Policy Renewal Rating Worksheet
content:
The indicated renewal premium of a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy is worked out on the renewal offer date from the records on file that day.

## Rating clause

1. The building premium is the rated building amount divided by 1,000, multiplied by the building rate and by the tier's building rate factor.
2. The rated building amount is the building limit on file, and the building rate is the zone building rate of the flood zone on file.
3. The contents premium is the contents limit on file divided by 1,000 and multiplied by the tier's contents rate per 1,000.
4. The indicated renewal premium is the building premium plus the contents premium, rounded half-up to the cent once at the end, and never less than the tier's minimum annual premium.

## Zone building rates

| Flood zone on file | Zone building rate (per 1,000 of rated building amount) |
|---|---|
| X | 0.64 |
| A | 3.87 |
| AE | 2.96 |
| VE | 6.42 |

## How the figures combine

The building premium enters the sum only after every load or credit rated on the building premium has acted on it, each one multiplying the building premium as already adjusted by the one before. The sum of that building premium and the contents premium is reduced once by any companion discount on the premium. Rounding half-up to the cent and the tier's minimum annual premium are applied only to that final figure: the building premium, the contents premium and every intermediate figure are carried unrounded.

## Worksheet lines, worked on hypothetical figures

The tier figures below (building rate factor of 1.09, contents rate per 1,000 of 1.24, minimum annual premium 300.00) are hypothetical inputs chosen for the illustration; the figures for an actual policy are the ones of its own tier.

Case A — hypothetical building in zone A, building limit on file 125,000, contents limit on file 30,000.

| Line | Entry | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Rated building amount divided by 1,000 | 125 |
| 2 | Building rate, zone A | 3.87 |
| 3 | Line 1 multiplied by line 2, then by the building rate factor of 1.09 | 483.75, then 527.2875 |
| 4 | Contents limit divided by 1,000, multiplied by 1.24 | 30 multiplied by 1.24 is 37.20 |
| 5 | Line 3 plus line 4 | 564.4875 |
| 6 | Rounded half-up to the cent | 564.49 |
| 7 | Compared with the minimum annual premium 300.00 | 564.49 stands |

Case B — hypothetical building in zone X, building limit on file 50,000, contents limit on file 20,000. The building premium is 50 multiplied by 0.64, which is 32.00, multiplied by 1.09, which is 34.88; the contents premium is 20 multiplied by 1.24, which is 24.80; their sum is 59.68. That is below the minimum annual premium of 300.00, so the indicated renewal premium is 300.00.

In case A the building premium is not rounded on line 3; the single rounding on line 6 is what brings 564.4875 to 564.49.
